treatment: Repeat only for model card, weights/license details, independently reproducible benchmarks, material availability changes, or significant deployment/adoption evidence.
known_facts: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning as an open model aimed at code review, tool use, security alert monitoring, billing questions and other enterprise tasks.
NVIDIA positioned the model as a smaller, lower-cost option than larger frontier systems.
The release was reported by Reuters after the prior LLM Night Lite boundary.
reinclude_only_if: Official model card or weights/license details materially change practical interpretation.
Independent reproducible evaluation establishes a meaningful capability or efficiency delta.
A major deployment or compatibility change materially affects use.
notes: NeMo Switchyard was discussed in the same announcement cycle, but the project/package had public availability before this run, so it is not treated as a separate NEW release topic here.
